Bill, a lonely robot in an apocalyptic wasteland, goes on a journey to find happiness and a purpose. Little does he know, he is about to start a very unexpected friendship.
"Love Bytes" by Sam Prebble
Connect with the Filmmakers:
Director’s Statement:
"Love Bytes" was my first animated short film. From a very young age, I always wanted to be a filmmaker, but my experience is more in game design and visual effects.
